avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may reduce raloxifene bioavailability and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor for reduced therapeutic effect

avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate anticoagulant effects and increase thrombotic risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose supplementation; use only under medical supervision

caution_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May impair raloxifene absorption if taken simultaneously; raloxifene itself indicated for bone health
caution_supplements.action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours

caution_supplements.name: Iron supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May reduce raloxifene absorption through GI binding
caution_supplements.action: Administer iron supplements at least 2 hours apart from raloxifene

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: May significantly increase raloxifene absorption and systemic exposure, increasing adverse effects risk
avoid_foods.action: Take raloxifene with consistent fat intake or on fasting state as directed

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may marginally increase raloxifene levels; minor interaction potential
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption or monitor for increased side effects

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous vegetables (high intake)
caution_foods.mechanism: May induce glucuronidation and reduce raloxifene exposure
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent dietary intake; excessive changes should be avoided

monitoring_notes: Monitor for venous thromboembolism (VTE) risk, especially in immobilized patients. Assess bone mineral density response and counsel on adequate calcium/vitamin D intake separate from raloxifene dosing.
